Home Maintenance Calendar

Generate a full 12-month home maintenance schedule: monthly chores, seasonal tasks and annual checks, laid out month by month.

Ordered for northern-hemisphere seasons — southern-hemisphere users can read the schedule shifted by 6 months.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the starting month (usually the current one).
  2. Optionally tick if you have extras like a pool, fireplace or garden.
  3. Press Generate for a 12-month calendar of tasks.
  4. Check tasks off as you do them — progress is saved in your browser.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do the tasks come from?

A built-in checklist used by homeowner guides: monthly items (filters, detectors), seasonal items (gutters in fall, AC in spring) and annual checks.

Is my check-off progress saved?

Yes — in your browser's localStorage, keyed to the start month. Regenerating with a different start month gives a fresh list.

Does it know my climate?

Tasks are ordered for northern-hemisphere seasons. Southern-hemisphere users can read the schedule shifted by 6 months — noted on the page.
